Title: Research Engineer
Description: - Led the architecture and end-to-end development of contactless solutions, providing technical support to enterprise customers throughout the product lifecycle.  - Analyzed the Apple VAS protocol and designed a high-performance communication layer over Android ISO-DEP using raw APDU command/response sequences, ensuring reliable and low-latency transactions.  - Designed an interface-based, reusable contactless architecture that supports heterogeneous protocols and future standards through service-layer extensions, minimizing changes to underlying communication and application layers while improving maintainability.  - Architected an Android background service using AIDL-based IPC to encapsulate cryptographic and communication logic behind stable APIs for external applications and enterprise partners.

Title: Assistant Research Engineer
Description: - Evaluated, profiled, and validated low-level payment kernels and driver-level APIs across newly launched hardware platforms.  - Consolidated 10 previously separate, hardware-dependent payment applications into a unified codebase using Android Build Flavors, enabling shared payment logic while isolating client-specific UI and configuration.  - Re-engineered multithreading, asynchronous processing pipelines, and memory management to eliminate critical ANR issues and improve system stability.  - Developed BMT (Benchmark Test) applications and led device validation and stabilization for high-profile customer and PR events, contributing to 6 new corporate client contracts.

Title: Engineer
Description: - Developed a contactless payment kernel in compliance with Mastercard EMV Level 2 specifications and successfully achieved official Mastercard EMV Level 2 Certification.  - Performed protocol-level root-cause analysis using raw APDU traces to diagnose and resolve compatibility issues between embedded terminal software and payment cards.  - Identified and resolved critical memory leaks and OOM issues during continuous transaction stress testing by optimizing memory allocation and lifecycle management at the kernel layer.

Title: Researcher
Description: - Investigated architectural security vulnerabilities in the Automotive Grade Linux (AGL) infotainment platform, resulting in the discovery of 3 CVEs and research published at ACM CODASPY.  - Developed anomaly detection techniques based on message-ID sequences for unmanned systems, resulting in 5 domestic and international patent registrations.  - Developed automated fuzzing environments and seed-generation techniques to identify software vulnerabilities and improve testing efficiency.

Title: Software Engineer
Description: - Developed an automated PCAP traffic generator for dynamically generating network traffic to test and validate Suricata IDS rules.

Title: Penetration Tester
